transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. What brings you in today?

I’m here because I know the new owners are out to destroy my name, no matter what anyone says. They are quietly spreading lies to make sure I can't get work anywhere else. I know what they're doing behind my back, even if everyone else tells me I'm just being paranoid.
How long have you been feeling that the new owners are targeting you and spreading lies about you?

It's been going on for about two months now, ever since they cut my hours and promoted that younger bartender over me. It has been constant every single day since then, and I know they won't stop until my reputation is completely ruined.
Have you ever heard voices or noticed anything else that others around you don’t seem to hear or notice?

No, I'm not hearing voices or seeing things that aren't physically there. But I definitely notice what's happening behind the scenes with the owners sabotaging me, even if other people try to dismiss it as paranoia.
Have these beliefs about the owners trying to ruin your reputation been present for more than six months, or have they developed more recently?

They're actually pretty recent, only starting about two months ago. I've never had thoughts like this before in my life. They only began after I had already sunk into this really dark, hopeless state where everything felt completely drained.
Before these thoughts about the owners started, did you also experience a loss of interest in activities, low energy, or feelings of worthlessness as part of your 'dark, hopeless state'?

Yes, that heavy, dark state definitely started first. I had already lost all interest in my hobbies, felt completely drained of energy, and felt like a total failure. It was only after I sank into that hopeless place that I became convinced they were actively trying to ruin my reputation.
